query: When was Pluto unlisted as a planet?

semantic_search_results.section_text: In 2006, the International Astronomical Union (IAU) adopted a formal definition of '''planet'''. Pluto does not clear the neighborhood around its orbit, so it was reclassified as a ''dwarf planet''.
The definition adopted on 24 August 2006 states that a '''planet''' must orbit the Sun, be rounded by its own gravity, and have cleared the neighbourhood around its orbit.
A '''dwarf planet''' is a small planetary-mass object in direct orbit around the Sun, smaller than the eight classical planets but still a world in its own right.
